payload.body: You tend to agree to the date, decor, purchase, or social plan because it keeps things pleasant, then feel dissatisfied with something you helped choose. Being easy to get along with and being honest about what you want do not always fit comfortably together. This often reflects an old habit of treating preference as conflict. Change one small choice before the resentment becomes the only honest part.
